lines.text: Buy on TrenchMart, and your SOL is not paid to the seller. Not yet.
lines.say: Buy on TrenchMart, and your sole is not paid to the seller. Not yet.

lines.text: One signature creates an escrow account on-chain and funds it with your SOL.
lines.say: One signature creates an escrow account on-chain, and funds it with your sole.

lines.text: The program holds it for one hour. You can download once it confirms.
Something off? Open a dispute inside that hour, and the escrow freezes.
No dispute? It releases on its own. The seller is paid, the fee is split.
Don't take our word for it. Every escrow is a real account on Solana devnet. Check it in the explorer.
